Interface CassandraValueProvider

All Superinterfaces:
PropertyValueProvider<CassandraPersistentProperty>
All Known Subinterfaces:
CassandraRowValueProvider
All Known Implementing Classes:
RowValueProvider, TupleValueProvider, UdtValueProvider
public interface CassandraValueProvider extends PropertyValueProvider<CassandraPersistentProperty>
PropertyValueProvider 用于 CassandraPersistentProperty。此 PropertyValueProvider 允许查询源对象是否包含针对 CassandraPersistentProperty（如字段或列）的数据源。
Since:
1.5
